summary: @ornikar/monorepo-config preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute obfuscated 727KB sibling payload
details: The package advertises itself as a monorepo configuration utility but ships an obfuscated preinstall launcher (setup.mjs) that fires automatically on npm install. setup.mjs uses obfuscator.io-style hex identifiers and per-function string dictionaries to hide its behavior; it downloads the Bun runtime (github.com/oven-sh/bun v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and then invokes execFileSync on the bundled sibling file math_init.js under that Bun binary. math_init.js is a 727KB opaque bun-cjs compiled bundle beginning with '// @bun @bun-cjs' followed by a shuffled numeric constant array and a rotating array-decoder function (WV8StW). Neither the package name nor README documents a compiled Bun payload, and the filename 'math_init.js' does not correspond to any advertised functionality. The choice to fetch a second language runtime specifically to execute the opaque payload places the actual install-time behavior outside the code path a reviewer inspecting Node-resolved source would trace, and the launcher's own obfuscation is inconsistent with legitimate infrastructure. Installing this version runs the hidden Bun-compiled payload on the installer's machine with the installer's privileges.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
